strings.Mỗi ngày được lái xe đi chơi một chuyến:: Take one ride a day: to the sea, to watch the sunset, a flight over the street. Spirits go up for a little fuel money.
strings.Khung thép, giỏ mây đằng trước, chuông k: Steel frame, a wicker basket up front, a bell that goes ding-ding. Fits a bunch of flowers.
strings.Sạc một đêm chạy cả ngày, lên dốc cầu nh: Charge it overnight, ride all day; bridge slopes feel like nothing.

strings.Dáng tròn, yên da nâu, cốp rộng để vừa á: Round body, brown leather seat, a trunk that fits a raincoat and a lunch box.
strings.Nhỏ gọn, len hẻm xe hơi dễ dàng, máy lạn: Small and nimble in car alleys, with cool air-con on sunny days.
strings.Gầm cao, cốp rộng, đủ chỗ chở cả nhà về: High clearance, a big trunk, room to take the whole family home for the holidays.
strings.Sơn bóng loáng, vô lăng gỗ, mở mui ra là: Glossy paint, a wooden wheel; drop the top and the whole street turns to look.
strings.Hai cánh buồm trắng, cabin nhỏ đủ pha ấm: Two white sails and a little cabin just big enough to brew tea. Moored at the pier past the dike.
strings.Boong gỗ rộng, phòng ngủ dưới khoang, sâ: A wide wooden deck, a cabin below, a sun deck for sunsets over the bay.
strings.Hai chỗ ngồi, cánh cao, cất cánh từ đườn: Two seats, high wings, takes off from the grass strip at the private airfield.
Eight leather seats, as smooth as your living room. Fly to the island for seafood on the weekend and back.
strings.Gió bờ kênh mát rượi, bạn ghé mua ly nướ: A cool breeze along the canal; you stop for a sugarcane juice and drift home.
strings.Một vòng quanh chợ, cô bán hoa dúi cho c: A loop around the market; the flower lady tucks a sprig of daisies into your basket.
strings.Đường chiều vắng, đèn phố vừa lên. Đầu ó: Quiet evening streets, the lamps just coming on. Your head feels light.
strings.Mở cửa kính, bật bài hát quen, chạy dọc: Windows down, a favourite song on, you drive along the river until the sun is gone.
strings.Bà Tám đi nhờ ra chợ đầu mối, khen xe êm: Grandma Tám catches a ride to the wholesale market and says the car is ever so smooth.
strings.Ghé quán bánh xèo ngoại ô, ăn xong lái v: You stop at a bánh xèo place out of town and drive home slowly after.
strings.Neo ngoài vịnh, mặt trời lặn đỏ rực sau: Anchored in the bay, the sun sets red behind the hills. The salty breeze feels lovely.
strings.Bầy cá chuồn nhảy quanh mũi thuyền. Bạn: Flying fish leap around the bow. You cast a line and don't care if anything bites.
strings.Ngồi trên boong pha ấm trà, nghe sóng vỗ: You brew tea on deck and listen to the waves lapping.
strings.Từ trên cao, cả khu phố nhỏ như mô hình:: From up high the whole neighbourhood looks like a model: you can even spot Grandma Tám's roof.
strings.Bay qua dòng sông lúc hoàng hôn, mây hồn: You fly over the river at sunset, pink clouds stretching to the horizon.
strings.Hạ cánh xuống đảo, ăn đĩa ghẹ hấp rồi ba: You land on the island, eat a plate of steamed crab and fly back in time for dinner.

strings.✅ Hồ sơ không sai bước nào được 32 xu. M: ✅ A dossier with no wrong step pays 32 xu. Each mistake takes a little off; on probation it takes less.
strings.Tính là sai lý do. Mỗi lần trừ 5 xu thưở: Counts as a wrong reason. Each one takes 5 xu off the tray bonus (2 xu on probation), never below 14 xu.
strings.Bớt 8 xu thưởng hồ sơ (thử việc 4 xu) và: 8 xu off the dossier bonus (4 xu on probation) and −3 trust. Work left unfinished at day end costs 2 trust each, up to 6.
strings.⏰ Chuyển lương trước hạn. Hồ sơ không sa: ⏰ Send the payroll before the deadline. A dossier with no wrong step gets the full bonus; each mistake costs 4 xu (2 xu on probation).
strings.Bớt 8 xu thưởng (thử việc 4 xu), mất 3 t: 8 xu off the bonus (4 xu on probation), −3 trust; a late payroll costs 2 more. Late returns: 3 xu a day; on day 5 the boss files it for you, −3 trust.
strings.⏰ Nộp trước hạn: +2 tin tưởng, tin tưởng: ⏰ Hand in before the deadline: +2 trust; at 75 trust or more, +5 xu. No wrong step pays 32 xu.
strings.Mất 20 phút (thử việc 13 phút), mất 1 ti: Costs 20 minutes (13 on probation) and 1 trust; the matching-board bonus loses 4 xu per mistake (2 xu on probation).
strings.Mất thêm 15 phút (thử việc 8 phút), thưở: Costs 15 more minutes (8 on probation) and the bonus shrinks. Even with many mistakes you still get 14 xu.
strings.Thuế & kế toán: mỗi hồ sơ thưởng thêm 2: Tax & accounting: every dossier pays 2 xu more, and even with many mistakes you get at least 14 xu (was 10).
strings.Đang thử việc nghề văn phòng: sai một bư: On probation in an office job: a wrong step costs only 2 xu, you always keep half the bonus, lateness costs less, fixing mistakes takes less time.
strings.Mỗi lần ghép sai tốn thêm thời gian soát: Each wrong match costs extra time to recheck (less while on probation).

strings.Đổi nghề, quay lại chỗ làm cũ thế nào?: How do I switch jobs or go back to an old workplace?
strings.🧭 Mở [[Hành trình]], kéo xuống “Nơi làm: 🧭 Open [[Journey]], scroll down to “Workplace”, then tap [[Continue]] or [[Start]] on the place you want.
strings.🔁 Game mở lại đúng nơi bạn làm lần trước: 🔁 The game reopens the place you worked last time, which is why it feels like “always the same place”. You can switch any time.
strings.⚠️ Làm xong việc đang dở hoặc bấm [[Khép: ⚠️ Finish the task in progress or tap [[Close today's shift]] before you go, so you aren't fined for leaving work unfinished.

strings.💼 Chỉ nơi làm thuê (giáo viên, nhà thuốc: 💼 Only employed jobs (teacher, pharmacy, office…) need you to resign. Tap [[Close today's shift]] first.
strings.📋 Rồi mở [[Việc làm]] trong menu, ở Hồ s: 📋 Then open [[Tasks]] in the menu, and in the Job file tap [[Quit the job]]. To work there again, just apply again.
strings.🏪 Tiệm của bạn thì cứ sang nơi khác. Muố: 🏪 For your own shop, just go somewhere else. To skip the upkeep cost: [[Your money]] → [[Invest, pause]] → [[Pause]].
strings.Mở thêm nghề mới thế nào?: How do I unlock new jobs?
strings.📚 Nơi làm mới mở theo chương. Làm đủ các: 📚 New workplaces open by chapter. Finish every “To-do” item of the chapter in [[Journey]] to unlock more.
strings.🔒 Ô “Sắp mở” ở cuối “Nơi làm việc” là cá: 🔒 The “Opening soon” tiles at the end of “Workplace” are the next chapter's places. Employed jobs and offices open later.
strings.Làm nghề gì có nhiều tiền?: Which jobs make the most money?
strings.🏪 Tiệm của bạn: tiền lời vào quỹ tiệm. L: 🏪 Your own shop: profit goes into the shop fund. Do it right, earn 5★ and order just enough stock to sell, and you'll profit a lot.
strings.💼 Làm thuê: lương cố định mỗi ngày. Nơi: 💼 Employed: a fixed wage every day. Places that open later pay more, like pilot 65–110 coins or Group Accountant 50–120 coins.
strings.👛 Tiền lời nằm trong quỹ tiệm, nhớ rút v: 👛 Profit stays in the shop fund, so remember to withdraw it to your wallet to spend it.
strings.👛 Chạm ô tiền ở góc trên để mở [[Tiền củ: 👛 Tap the money chip at the top to open [[Your money]]. Money in a shop fund: tap [[Withdraw to your wallet]] at the place you want to withdraw from.
strings.🏦 Tiền trong ngân hàng: mở [[Ngân hàng]]: 🏦 Money in the bank: open [[Bank]], type the amount in coins, then tap [[Withdraw]]. Street Bank ATMs charge no fee.
strings.🔒 Quỹ tiệm luôn giữ lại 80 xu và tiền hó: 🔒 The shop fund always keeps 80 coins plus money for unpaid bills, so you can't withdraw all of it.
strings.Làm giáo viên (làm thuê) sao chưa có lươ: I work as a teacher (employed), so why haven't I been paid?
strings.📝 Phải được nhận việc trước: [[Xin việc]: 📝 You have to be hired first: [[Apply]], pass the interview, then sign the contract.
strings.💵 Lương trả khi bấm [[Khép ca hôm nay]],: 💵 Pay comes when you tap [[Close today's shift]], if you finished at least 1 task that day (teacher: teach 1 full lesson). Probation pays 85%.
👛 Pay goes straight to your wallet, not the shop fund. Look for the “Daily pay …” line in the wallet log.

strings.🍱 Buổi trưa (11:30–13:30 giờ tiệm) thẻ v: 🍱 At lunchtime (11:30–13:30 shop time) the task card asks “Lunchtime! What'll it be?”: pick a dish.
strings.🍢 Đói hay buồn ngủ giữa ca: chọn món ở “: 🍢 Hungry or sleepy mid-shift: pick something from “Extra food” on the task card or in Everyday, paid from your wallet. ☕ Coffee keeps you Alert.
strings.🌙 Tối khép ca, chọn bữa tối và ngủ sớm:: 🌙 When you close the day, choose a dinner and go to bed early: sleep at 22:00 and you'll have 100 Alert the next morning.
strings.Kho ở đâu, nhập hàng thế nào?: Where's the stock, and how do I restock?
strings.📦 Tiệm bán hàng nào cũng có kho riêng. C: 📦 Every shop that sells goods has its own stock. How to open it at your current workplace is in the job guide, under Restock.
strings.🛒 Chọn món, số lượng và nhà cung cấp rồi: 🛒 Pick the item, quantity and supplier, then tap [[Place order]]. When the goods arrive, open the crate, count it, then put it on the shelf.
strings.💼 Nơi làm thuê (lớp học, văn phòng…) khô: 💼 Employed workplaces (classroom, office…) have no stock.

strings.💍 Mở menu [[Khu phố]] → [[Lịch cưới]]. T: 💍 Open the [[Neighborhood]] menu → [[Wedding calendar]]. The party opens 5 minutes early and lasts 10 minutes: tap [[Attend]].
strings.🪙 Có tài khoản thì mỗi phút ở lại được 2: 🪙 With an account, you get 20 coins for every minute you stay (up to 2 weddings a day). Without an account, you can only watch.
strings.💌 Bạn bè cưới sẽ mời bạn và nhắc trước g: 💌 Friends who get married will invite you and remind you before the party.
strings.Mừng cưới bao nhiêu?: How much should I give as a wedding gift?
strings.🧧 Tùy lòng, không bắt buộc. Trong tiệc b: 🧧 It's up to you, not required. At the party tap 🧧, choose 10, 20, 50, 100 or 200 coins and a wish, then [[Send envelope]].
strings.👛 Tiền lấy từ ví, chia đôi cho cô dâu ch: 👛 The money comes from your wallet and is split between the bride and groom. Up to 500 coins per wedding. Requires an account.

strings.Bón thúc cho kịp lứa: Boost a bed to ripen sooner
strings.Mở luống đang lớn, chọn liều [[Phân bón: Open a growing bed and pick a dose of [[Foliar booster]]: each dose cuts 10% of the growing time, up to 70% per crop, still organic. Costs coins and 1 soil fertility per dose.
strings.🧴 Phân bón lá thúc không cần nhập kho: m: 🧴 The foliar booster needs no stock: buy it right at the bed, each dose a little dearer than the last. Not in the rain or on parched soil.
strings.Thu hoạch luống chín (vùng xanh) → hàng: Harvest ripe beds (green zone) → produce into cold storage → pack the right grade and count into each crate → honest labels (organic only when the batch used no chemicals) → deliver. Between orders: water by the forecast, weed, check for pests (bad pests spread to the next bed overnight), add compost when the soil is worn out, spray the foliar booster when you need produce sooner (up to 70% less growing time, costs coins and soil fertility), rotate crop groups when replanting, feed the hens, clean the henhouse, collect eggs. Surplus near expiry: sell wholesale in the 📈 Market tab, and pick a good-price moment.

strings.Số lượng THỰC GIAO (Biên bản giao nhận): Quantity ACTUALLY DELIVERED (Delivery record) × Unit price before tax (Purchase order).
strings.Số dư cuối kỳ theo Sổ tiền gửi, cộng tiề: Closing balance per the bank deposit ledger, plus money in / minus money out for the items that still need recording.
strings.Cộng cột “Còn phải thu” của mọi hóa đơn: Add up the “Still receivable” column of every invoice not yet fully collected (Acct 131 receivables subledger).
strings.Bảng kiểm đếm: mỗi dòng mệnh giá × số tờ: Cash count sheet: each row is denomination × number of bills, then add them up.
strings.Sổ quỹ: tồn quỹ đầu ngày + các phiếu thu: Cash book: opening cash balance + cash receipts − payment vouchers.
strings.Nguyên giá ÷ (số năm × 12), theo Sổ tài: Historical cost ÷ (years × 12), per the Fixed asset register. First used this month or fully depreciated: enter 0.
strings.Nguyên giá − hao mòn lũy kế − khấu hao t: Historical cost − accumulated depreciation − this month's depreciation (Fixed asset register).
strings.Thực đếm (Biên bản kiểm kê) − Tồn theo s: Actual count (Stock-count report) − Stock per the books (Stock card). A shortage is negative; if it matches, enter 0.
strings.Số lượng thiếu (bước trước) × Đơn giá vố: Quantity short (previous step) × Unit cost on the Stock card.
strings.Thuế đầu ra (TK 3331) − thuế đầu vào đượ: Output tax (Acct 3331) − deductible input tax (Acct 133), on the balances sheet.
strings.Tổng cột Dư Nợ và tổng cột Dư Có của bản: Total of the Debit balance column and total of the Credit balance column on the trial balance: subtract the smaller total from the larger.
Acct 511 balance in the General ledger.
Net revenue − Cost of goods sold (Acct 632).
strings.Lợi nhuận gộp − chi phí bán hàng (641) −: Gross profit − selling expenses (641) − administrative expenses (642), using the corrected figures.
strings.Bấm 📦 Nhập để đặt hàng → thùng về thì mở: Tap 📦 Restock to order → when the crate arrives, open it in 📦 Stock and tap to count each item → new stock goes on the shelf. Adjust selling prices with − / +.
strings.Số dư trên Sổ phải thu − số dư trên Sổ p: Balance on the Receivables ledger − balance on the Payables ledger.
strings.Số dư của bên KHÔNG phải điều chỉnh (the: The balance of the side that does NOT need adjusting (based on the cause in the previous step).
strings.Hàng nội bộ CÒN TỒN cuối kỳ (giá nội bộ): Intercompany goods STILL IN STOCK at period end (intercompany price) × gross margin rate; the part already sold externally doesn't count.
strings.Tổng cổ tức (Nghị quyết) × tỷ lệ sở hữu: Total dividend (Resolution) × the parent company's ownership percentage (Ownership structure).

So close! The board was spinning hard.

strings.Cái muôi đồng cán quấn vải: Copper ladle with a cloth-wrapped handle
strings.Bác Lâm mang từ Nam Định lên, ba mươi nă: Uncle Lâm brought it up from Nam Định, thirty years of ladling broth. Pick it up and you know: one scoop fills one bowl.
strings.Ba giờ sáng, đèn quán đã sáng. Bác Lâm c: Three in the morning, the shop lights are already on. Uncle Lâm blanches the bones, rinsing each piece under cold water.
strings.Xương phải chần cho sạch máu, nước mới t: Bones must be blanched until the blood is gone, or the broth won't be clear. Ginger and scallions get charred, scraped clean, then dropped in.
strings.Ninh lửa nhỏ, mặt nồi chỉ lăn tăn. Sôi t: Simmer on low heat, just a gentle bubble on top. Let it boil hard for a while and the broth stays cloudy all day, no fixing it.
Yes, I'll watch the heat for you, Uncle.
strings.Ông giáo Thụ trải tờ báo, chưa ăn vội mà: Teacher Thụ spreads out his newspaper, and before eating he sips a spoonful of broth first.
strings.Phở là ở nước. Nước trong nhìn thấy đáy: Phở is all in the broth. Clear enough to see the bottom of the bowl, sweet from bones, not from MSG.
strings.Ông già rồi, uống mì chính vào là khô cổ: I'm old now. MSG leaves my throat dry all morning.
strings.Nồi nhỏ kia bác nấu riêng cho ông giáo đ: That small pot, Uncle cooks just for the teacher, kid.
strings.Ông giáo hỏi chuyện nồi nước: The teacher asks about the broth pot
strings.Múc nước ở nồi nhỏ, mời ông nếm lại: Ladle from the small pot, invite him to taste again
strings.Đấy, thế này mới là phở. Cháu nhớ lời ôn: There, that's phở. You remembered what I told you.
strings.Hỏi ông phở ngày xưa thế nào: Ask him what phở was like in the old days
strings.Ngày xưa phở gánh, một gánh hai đầu: một: In the old days it was street-peddler phở, one pole, two ends: broth pot on one end, noodles and meat on the other. As long as the broth was hot, it was good.
strings.Gió mùa về, ngõ vắng hoe. Hơi nước trên: The monsoon is here, the alley is empty. Steam rises white from the phở pot.
strings.Lạnh thế này bán xôi chẳng ai mua, chị s: Nobody buys sticky rice in this cold, so I came over for a bowl of phở to warm up.
strings.Nước béo nhé em, hớt mặt nồi ấy, có tí t: Fatty broth, please, skim from the top of the pot, a bit of marrow makes it good.
strings.Trời lạnh tô nguội nhanh. Chan xong bưng: Bowls go cold fast in this weather. Ladle it and serve right away, don't keep customers waiting.
strings.Nồi nước vừa châm, chưa sôi lại: The pot was just refilled, not boiling yet
strings.Xin chị chờ một phút cho nồi lăn tăn lại: Please wait a minute, ma'am, until the pot is simmering again
Sure, I can wait. Rare beef is best cooked just pink.
strings.Mời chị cốc trà nóng trong lúc chờ: Offer her a cup of hot tea while she waits
This shop is so thoughtful. No wonder it's busy.
strings.Chị Hạnh dắt bé Bống vào, bé ôm cái cặp: Hạnh leads little Bống in, the child hugging a schoolbag bigger than herself.
strings.Bé nhà chị kén lắm, thấy hành là gạt ra,: My little one is so picky. She pushes out any scallions and won't eat if there's too much broth.
strings.Em làm tô chín, không hành, ít nước, bán: I'll make her a well-done bowl, no scallions, little broth, noodles blanched soft.
strings.Hôm nay bé ăn sạch tô! Lần đầu tiên đấy: Today she finished the whole bowl! First time ever.
strings.Bác Lâm lau cái muôi đồng sáng bóng, tre: Uncle Lâm wipes the copper ladle until it shines, hangs it on the hook, takes it down again, and hands it to you.
strings.Ba mươi năm bác múc bằng cái muôi này. M: Thirty years I've ladled with this one. Any ladle will do, what matters is stopping your hand at the right moment.
strings.Mai bác về quê giỗ cụ, quán giao con mấy: Tomorrow I'm going back to the village for the ancestors' memorial. I'm leaving the shop to you for a few days.
strings.Giao đúng người. Nước trong, tái hồng, c: Left to the right person. Clear broth, pink rare beef, the kid can do it.
strings.Mai chị vẫn sang ăn, nước béo nhé!: I'll still come by tomorrow, fatty broth please!
You keep the broth pot the way I've kept it.
strings.vừa miệng, ngọt xương: just right, sweet from the bones
strings.muôi sâu, dưới lớp mỡ: a deep scoop, under the fat layer
strings.hớt lớp mỡ tủy trên mặt: skim the marrow fat off the top

strings.Bài 1 · Trụng bánh, xếp thịt: Lesson 1 · Blanch the noodles, lay the meat
strings.Bác Lâm đứng cạnh: “Nhúng rổ bánh ba bốn: Uncle Lâm stands beside you: “Dip the noodle basket three or four times and the noodles go loose and soft. Lay the meat on top, then ladle.”
strings.Bác Lâm dặn: “Chan tới đâu là do tay con: Uncle Lâm tells you: “How much you ladle is up to your hand. If the customer wants little or lots of broth, stop the ladle right at that line.”
strings.Bài 3 · Nồi nước và lời dặn: Lesson 3 · The broth pot and special requests
strings.Bác Lâm nhắc: “Nồi phải lăn tăn mới chín: Uncle Lâm reminds you: “The pot has to be at a gentle simmer for the rare beef to cook. If a customer says no MSG, ladle from the small pot.”
strings.Khoan con, bánh mới nhúng một hai lượt,: Hold on, kid, the noodles were only dipped once or twice, still clumped. Dump the bowl, blanch again three or four times.
strings.Bánh nhúng lâu quá, nát rồi. Đổ tô làm l: The noodles were dipped too long, they're mushy. Dump the bowl and redo it, three or four dips is just right.
strings.Khoan, chưa đúng món khách gọi. Coi lại: Hold on, that's not what the customer ordered. Check the ticket, and any wrong bowl gets dumped and redone.
strings.Có tô khách đâu có gọi. Bỏ tô dư ra đã c: That's a bowl nobody ordered. Set the extra bowl aside first, kid.
strings.Tái còn đỏ au kìa, nồi chưa đủ sôi. Đổ t: The rare beef is still bright red, the pot isn't hot enough. Dump the bowl, wait for the pot to simmer again, then ladle.
strings.Khách dặn không mì chính! Đổ tô, múc nướ: The customer said no MSG! Dump the bowl, ladle broth from the small pot for them.
strings.Khách dặn nước béo, con múc nước trong r: The customer asked for fatty broth, and you ladled clear broth. Ladle again with the skimming ladle.
strings.Nước chưa tới vạch khách dặn. Bấm chan t: The broth hasn't reached the customer's line. Tap ladle to add more.
strings.Nước nhiều hơn khách dặn rồi. Lần sau dừ: There's more broth than the customer asked for. Next time stop the ladle a bit sooner.
It spilled over the rim, it'll burn the customer's hand. Dump the bowl and redo it.
You forgot the scallions on this bowl, kid.
strings.Hành chưa đúng lời khách dặn. Coi lại ph: The scallions aren't what the customer asked for. Check the ticket.
strings.Trứng phải đập vào trước rồi mới chan nư: The egg goes in first, then pour in the boiling broth so it cooks just right. Dump the bowl and redo it.
The egg isn't what the customer asked for.
strings.Khách dặn tái để riêng. Đổ hộp làm lại,: The customer wanted the rare beef on the side. Dump the box and redo it, rare beef in its own bag.
strings.Túi nước chưa buộc kìa, khách cầm là đổ: The broth bag isn't tied, the customer picks it up and it all spills.
strings.Dừng! Bánh hôm qua chua rồi, không được: Stop! Yesterday's noodles have gone sour, you can't sell them. Dump the bowl, throw out the old batch.
The customer ordered quẩy and you haven't taken enough.
The customer asked for a herb plate and bean sprouts.
strings.Người Nam Định, ba giờ sáng đã bắc nồi x: A Nam Định man, he sets the bone pot on at three in the morning and tastes the broth with the copper ladle.
strings.Sáng nào cũng đọc báo bên tô phở, nước t: Every morning he reads the paper over a bowl of phở, clear broth, no MSG.
strings.Ăn vội trước giờ đông khách, mê nước béo: Eats in a hurry before the rush, loves fatty broth and quẩy.
strings.Ăn tô lớn cho chắc bụng, hay mua mang về: Eats a large bowl to fill his belly, or buys takeaway for the whole crew.
strings.Đưa bé đi học rồi ghé ăn, tô của bé khôn: Drops the little one at school then stops by to eat, her bowl has no scallions and little broth.
strings.Mua mang về, lúc nào cũng vội, dặn tái đ: Buys takeaway, always in a rush, asks for the rare beef on the side.
strings.Ăn phở kiểu miền Nam: trứng trần, đĩa ra: Eats phở Southern style: poached egg, herb plate, bean sprouts.
Office workers stop by for breakfast, a steady stream of customers.
strings.Trời lạnh: phở nguội nhanh, nồi mất nhiệ: It's cold: phở cools fast, and the pot loses heat even faster. Keep a gentle simmer.
strings.Khách trú mưa ăn bát phở nóng, ngồi lâu: Customers sheltering from the rain eat hot phở and sit longer.
strings.Cả nhà đi ăn phở, tô lớn, trứng, quẩy gọ: Whole families come for phở, with large bowls, eggs, and lots of quẩy ordered.
strings.Năm giờ rưỡi đã có khách: nước béo đầu n: Customers by half past five: the fatty broth from the top of the pot is the best.
strings.Cho chị tô tái nạm, nước béo, hai cái qu: A bowl of rare beef and flank for me, fatty broth, two quẩy. Quick please, nobody's watching my sticky rice tray out there!
strings.Chị Nguyệt bán xôi đầu ngõ, tranh thủ ăn: Nguyệt sells sticky rice at the head of the alley and squeezes in a bite before the rush.
strings.Tô lớn tái chín. Hôm nay đổ bê tông, phả: Large bowl, rare and well-done. Pouring concrete today, I need a full belly.
strings.Anh Tuấn đội mũ bảo hộ, quần còn dính vữ: Tuấn wears his hard hat, his pants still splattered with mortar.
strings.Một tô chín cho bé, không hành, ít nước: One well-done bowl for the little one, no scallions, just a bit of broth, she eats very slowly.
Little Bống sits on a plastic stool, her legs swinging.
strings.Cho ông tô tái chín, nước trong, nhiều h: A bowl of rare and well-done for me, clear broth, extra scallions. And remember, I don't take MSG.
strings.Ông giáo trải tờ báo sáng lên bàn, đeo k: The teacher spreads his morning paper on the table and puts on his reading glasses.
strings.Em lấy một suất mang về, tái nạm, tái để: I'll take one takeaway order, rare beef and flank, rare beef on the side, just a little broth.
strings.Cô Linh vừa nghe điện thoại vừa nhìn đồn: Linh talks on the phone while glancing at her watch.
strings.Cho anh tô tái gầu, đập cái hột gà vô, t: Give me a bowl with rare and fatty brisket, crack an egg in, and add a herb plate and sprouts!
strings.Anh Sáu đậu xe tải đầu ngõ, giọng Sài Gò: Sáu parks his truck at the head of the alley, his Saigon voice booming.
strings.Chị Nguyệt bán hết xôi: Nguyệt sold out of sticky rice
strings.Tô bò viên, nước béo, nhiều hành. Hôm na: A bowl of beef balls, fatty broth, extra scallions. Sold out of sticky rice early today!
Nguyệt proudly shows her empty sticky rice tray.
strings.Tô lớn đặc biệt, đủ tái nạm gầu gân. Hai: Large special bowl, with rare, flank, fatty brisket, and tendon. Two more quẩy too.
Tuấn just got his weekly pay.
strings.Hôm nay ông ăn chín nạm, nước trong, đừn: Today I'll have well-done flank, clear broth, and no MSG please.
strings.Ông giáo khen bác Lâm vẫn giữ được vị ph: The teacher praises Uncle Lâm for still keeping the Nam Định phở flavor.
strings.Một tô tái nạm cho chị, một tô chín cho: One bowl of rare and flank for me, one well-done bowl for the little one, no scallions, little broth.
Little Bống begs for quẩy, Hạnh shakes her head.
strings.Hai suất mang về: một tái để riêng, một: Two takeaway orders: one with rare beef on the side, one well-done. Medium broth please.
strings.Cô Linh dặn: “Sếp em khó tính lắm.”: Linh says: “My boss is very hard to please.”
strings.Trời lạnh quá, cho anh tô lớn tái nạm, n: It's so cold, give me a large bowl of rare and flank, lots of broth, piping hot!
strings.Anh Sáu xoa hai bàn tay, hơi thở phả khó: Sáu rubs his hands together, his breath steaming.
strings.Ông giáo trú mưa: The teacher shelters from the rain
strings.Mưa thế này phải bát phở nóng. Tái chín,: In rain like this you need hot phở. Rare and well-done, extra scallions, no MSG.
strings.Ông giáo gấp ô, lau cặp kính mờ hơi nước: The teacher folds his umbrella and wipes his glasses, fogged with steam.
strings.Chủ nhật nghỉ, anh ăn tô lớn tái gầu, tr: It's my day off, so a large bowl of rare and fatty brisket, poached egg, three quẩy.
Tuấn brings his little boy along.
strings.Sớm thế này mới có nước béo ngon. Tái nạ: This early is when the fatty broth is best. Rare and flank, fatty broth, lots of broth please.
It's only half past five, still dark in the alley.
strings.Bốn suất mang về cho anh em công trình:: Four takeaway orders for the guys at the site: two rare and flank, rare beef on the side, two well-done. Four more quẩy too.
strings.Anh Tuấn chạy xe máy ra, sau xe buộc sẵn: Tuấn rides up on his motorbike, a foam box already strapped on the back.
strings.Ông giáo Thụ: “Phở ngon là ở nước trong,: Teacher Thụ: “Good phở is in the clear broth, where you can see the bottom of the bowl.”
strings.Ông giáo kể hồi xưa đi dạy, sáng nào cũn: The teacher recalls that back when he taught, he had a bowl of street-peddler phở every morning.
strings.Ông giáo cắt bài báo viết về phở Nam Địn: The teacher clips a newspaper article about Nam Định phở and pins it on the shop wall.
strings.Ông giáo gật gù: “Nước hôm nay ngọt xươn: The teacher nods: “The broth today is sweet from the bones. Good.”
strings.Chị Nguyệt: “Nước béo mới đậm, ăn xong b: Nguyệt: “Fatty broth is rich, and it carries me through selling sticky rice until noon.”
Nguyệt sets aside a packet of xôi xéo for the shop.
strings.Chị Nguyệt dắt mối mấy bà bán rau sang ă: Nguyệt brings a few vegetable sellers over to eat phở.
strings.Anh Tuấn: “Tô lớn mới đủ sức vác xi măng: Tuấn: “Only a large bowl gives me strength to haul cement.”
Tuấn brags that the site is about to put on its roof.
strings.Anh Tuấn bảo cả tổ thợ giờ chỉ ăn phở ở: Tuấn says the whole crew now eats phở only here.
strings.Chị Hạnh: “Bé Bống chịu ăn hết tô rồi đó: Hạnh: “Little Bống finished the whole bowl.”
strings.Bé Bống vẽ tặng quán cái nồi phở bốc khó: Little Bống drew the shop a steaming pot of phở as a gift.
strings.Chị Hạnh kể bé Bống được cô giáo khen ăn: Hạnh says little Bống's teacher praised her for eating well.
strings.Cô Linh: “Tái để riêng về văn phòng chần: Linh: “With the rare beef on the side, blanching it again at the office makes it delicious.”
Linh's boss praised her for buying phở so well.
strings.Cô Linh đặt phở cho cả phòng họp sáng th: Linh orders phở for the whole meeting room on Monday morning.
strings.Anh Sáu: “Ngoài này phở nước trong, ăn r: Sáu: “Up here the phở broth is clear, and after a while you get hooked.”
strings.Anh Sáu mang biếu bác Lâm chai tương đen: Sáu brings Uncle Lâm a bottle of Saigon dark sauce as a gift.
strings.Anh Sáu kể chuyến hàng ra Bắc lần này ch: Sáu says this trip north he's hauling nothing but Tết kumquat trees.
strings.Một nồi nước dùng to đùng bốc khói dưới: A huge steaming broth pot under the banyan tree, a noodle-blanching basket, a wooden chopping board, and a few plastic tables and chairs. Uncle Lâm simmers bones from three in the morning, and you stand at the stove beside him.

strings.Hớt bọt, nếm nước, nêm cho vừa: Skim the foam, taste the broth, season to balance

strings.Ông giáo Thụ: nước trong, không mì chính: Teacher Thụ: clear broth, no MSG

strings.Chị Hạnh và bé Bống: không hành, ít nước: Hạnh and little Bống: no scallions, light on broth
strings.Cô Linh: mang về, tái để riêng: Linh: takeaway, rare beef on the side
strings.Anh Sáu: trứng trần, đĩa rau giá: Sáu: poached egg, herb plate with bean sprouts
strings.Bánh tơi mềm, tái chín hồng: Loose, soft noodles, rare beef cooked to pink
strings.Nước đúng mức khách dặn: Broth at just the level the customer asked for

strings.Bếp than đỏ lửa, nồi nóng lên từ từ. Khó: The charcoal glows red, the pot warms up slowly. Coal smoke drifts out into the alley.
strings.Cứ chan nước đang còn ấm: Just ladle it while it's still warm
The broth is only lukewarm, the rare beef dropped in is still red. A few customers glance at each other.

strings.Một bé ngồi bàn ngoài với tay lấy đũa, b: A kid at the outside table reaches for chopsticks and a bowl of hot broth spills on the back of the hand. The kid screams.

strings.Bạn đứng bếp quán phở của bác Lâm dưới g: You run the kitchen at Uncle Lâm's phở shop under the banyan tree: keep the broth at a gentle simmer, clear and well seasoned, blanch the noodles loose, lay out the meat as the customer asked, ladle the broth and stop at the line, serve it steaming hot, and give the right change.
strings.Nồi xương ủ lửa từ đêm. [[Vặn lửa lăn tă: The bone pot has been simmering since the night before. strings.Lửa lăn tăn giữ 97 °C: tái chín hồng, nư: A gentle simmer at 97 °C: rare beef cooks pink, broth stays clear. High heat is fast but foams, and a long boil leaves the broth cloudy all day. Low heat isn't hot enough to cook the rare beef.
strings.Lấy tô, bấm [[Nhúng rổ bánh]] ba hoặc bố: Grab a bowl and press [[Dip the noodle basket]] three or four times. One or two dips and the noodles stay clumped; five or more and they go mushy.
strings.Xếp thịt lên mặt bánh trước khi chan. Kh: Lay the meat on the noodles before ladling. If the customer wants rare beef on the side, press [[Rare beef on the side]]. [[Add scallions]] as asked. For a poached egg, [[Crack an egg]] before ladling.
strings.Chọn nồi: nước trong, nước béo hay nồi n: Pick a pot: clear broth, fatty broth, or the small pot with no MSG. Press [[Ladle the broth]] and the broth rises in the bowl; press [[Stop the ladle]] when it reaches the green line the customer asked for.
strings.Lấy hộp mang về: tái để riêng, chan túi: Grab a takeaway box: rare beef on the side, ladle broth into the bag up to the line, then [[Tie the broth bag]]. Tuấn's crew orders four portions at once.
strings.Bấm [[Châm nồi]]: thêm nước và một mẻ xư: Press [[Refill the pot]]: more water and a batch of bones. The pot loses heat, foams, and turns bland: wait for a gentle simmer again, skim the foam, taste again, then ladle.
